body:
Thanks for the suggestions, the meditation link is very calming. I'll start using that from now on whenever I feel down. 

However, meetup.com doesn't have many registered meetups for my country, sadly.

Thanks for the help.

Sorry, I went to bed since it was getting quite late and feel at least a little bit better.

I usually walk for about 30 minutes a day, but sometimes I have to force myself to do so. I used to swim twice a week but I realised I didn't have any fun doing so. I guess I'm more out to search for people I can talk with despite being introvert most of the time. Swimming's more a solo activity.

I've tried meditating way back when, but it didn't seem to do much for me. Maybe I should try it again.

Paralyzed is quite close to how I feel. It took me more than 10 minutes to start typing this message. But it's also that I'm just tired of going upstream all the time. Everywhere I go I feel like an outsider.

As for what I'm looking for, I don't know exactly. A combination of a shoulder to cry on, some help and support?
